profile: C9_PIANO_TRIANGLE_NOTES_DELAY_CLOCKED_V1; capacity recipe uses piano ordinary notes and delay only, no profile expansion.

geometry.action_count_basis: 12 on×2 +9 matching off×3 +2 ignored off×1 =53; release completion requires4800 advances, larger than either epoch. Re-trigger and fifth-note steal use original allocator. Any contrary generator result is a fixture failure, not a reason to adjust counts after run.
geometry.input_apply_history_count_rule: 23 input accepts +53 distinct apply rows, generator must confirm no overlap; max128 is a safety cap, not permission to drop or pad rows.
geometry.event16: M1 L0 source reasoning confirms ignored_off, no release/consume
geometry.event20: M1 L0 confirms normalized ignored_off note74

metadata.includes: manifest, original plan/config/FRAME/reset/END, source/ROM/tool identity-only, execution/synthetic ledger/TX context descriptors; none are actual execution evidence.

volume_rule.partition: Arbitrary byte cuts [floor(i*B/K),floor((i+1)*B/K));80 raw/112 public/9 physical-line-index/144 math-index/1each threehistories; no empty/padded volumes. Original bytes and all copies retained.
volume_rule.boundary: Arbitrary byte boundaries may split UTF-8 or JSON lines. Consumer reads one unchanged logical stream; never restarts cycle/epoch/parser/model at a part. Metadata not additionally split.
volume_rule.old339: Original proposal omitted physical raw/public line index. Add9parts; same22GiB logical cap is a sum cap, not guaranteed sufficient for future M3 geometry.

outputs.result_shape: Versioned final JSON contains exact counts/full sidecar descriptors and first difference, not an in-memory list. No truncation to diagnostic_limit; all evidence remains in sidecars.

scratch.sqlite_settings: page_size4096, cache_size=-8192, temp_store=FILE, mmap_size=0, max_page_count=131072, journal_mode=DELETE, synchronous=FULL; monitor all sidefiles. These settings are proposed source requirements, not executed.

disk.accounting: Count each created logical/part/output/DB/journal/log/partial file once, include allocated cluster rounding and monitor GetDiskFreeSpace. Pre-reserve declared next write against category/global/free-space bounds. No compression/sparse-file credit.
disk.stop: Before a write crossing any cap, record RESOURCE_LIMIT; preserve all existing originals/partials within failure reserve. No automatic deletion of original/old-run files, no fallback disk or larger cap.

original_budget_arithmetic.equation: 44+4+4+0.25=52.25GiB<56GiB hardcreatedlimit; proposal only, no bytes generated/measurement

RSS.scope: Sum of the fixed Python supervisor and its one Python worker; include generator, reader, model, SQLite, buffers, output and monitoring. Generation and consumption sequential in the same worker.
RSS.allowed_children: Supervisor may start exactly one fixed Python worker suspended in an owned Job after explicit M2 permission. Worker may create threads, no subprocesses. No compiler/HDL/EDA/device/network.
RSS.Windows_API: GetProcessMemoryInfo WorkingSetSize/PeakWorkingSetSize for each held process handle
RSS.primary_peak: Conservative sum of per-process OS-latched PeakWorkingSetSize, including their noncoincident peaks. Report observed simultaneous sum separately. This stricter upper bound covers between-sample peaks.
RSS.other_metrics: Report PrivateUsage/PeakPagefileUsage separately as Windows commit counters; never label them RSS. System-wide file cache and external tool host are outside process RSS and disclosed.
RSS.missing_measurement: Any sampling gap>100ms, child identity drift, untracked descendant or unavailable native peak counter makes capacity MEASUREMENT_INCOMPLETE, never PASS.
RSS.enforcement: RSS is a measured success ceiling and immediate stop trigger, not a promise to prevent every transient allocation. A separate owned-Job worker commit cap of768MiB is proposed for hard allocation containment; supervisor is outside that worker Job and included in all RSS totals. Supervisor PrivateUsage>128MiB fails/stops the group. Neither commit counter is called RSS; exceeding512MiB process-tree RSS fails even if commit cap not reached.

time.counts: supervisor preparation before worker, imports/identities, all generation/volumes, inputs, state, math/audits, EOF/final identities, flush/fsync, process/Job/streams, receipts and supervisor exit

scope_limit: Synthetic geometry matches the full target length only. It does not approve actual D/D+1 finish, actual reset policy, C9 execution, physical timing, serial closure or real math.
input_identity_policy: No large fixture generated now. Freeze the recipe SHA and future generator/source SHA before approved launch; generated bodies receive actual bytes/SHA during the counted group and must match deterministic counts/upper bounds before consumption. No invented pre-generation SHA.
generation_failure: Any missing promised action/count/profile, byte cap breach or geometry mismatch stops the group as fixture failure; no mid-run shrink/row deletion/padding or retry.
source_runtime_gap: M3_R13 actual geometry/shape not delivered; do not substitute old39MBfrontend or proposed512MiBbackend measurements
